scope: Frozen RefCloth PNG; static binary surface masks; unchanged manipulation tasks, policy weights, scenes and cameras. Source-only region selection.
state_generation: 10 settling no-ops, then clean source-policy actions; queries reset exact simulator snapshots and do not step physics
primary_selection: Mean squared discrepancy from full texture in the first five action steps and six normalized pose coordinates. Translation and rotation receive equal group weight. Normalization equals inverse production action quantile half-ranges; gripper reported separately.
normalization: Relative fidelity is pooled error energy divided by pooled full-minus-plain pose energy; zero denominators explicitly undefined
greedy: Recompute all remaining single-block deletions after every accepted removal; use original full-texture action as the teacher throughout
visibility: Per-block native color-marker exposure after the same bilinear RGB resize as the policy input, averaged equally over two cameras and fit states. Not an action attribution.
boundaries: Hard binary block boundaries, identical for all binary controls. Report actual PNG RMS, TV, changed-pixel support, perimeter and camera exposure.
target_gate: Only if source gate passes: freeze all exported candidates and hashes before target queries; paired exploratory native closed-loop evaluation, no target-driven mask revision. Report intervals; no equivalence claim from nonsignificance.
patch_ownership: Controller records initial source XML status, patches once if needed; workers never unpatch; only controller restores after every child has exited. Do not change already-patched state.
claim_boundary: A generic mask/greedy method is established prior art. A positive source fidelity screen is not closed-loop success, physical hardware validation, transfer preservation, or proof of novelty.
